correctness.rationale: Grouping the full residue set modulo p gives uI+v(I_p⊗J_p)+J_{p²}; the three rational eigenvalues u, α, β with multiplicities p(p−1), p−1, 1 give a nonzero determinant. Away from p, the corresponding averaging projections are integral over each local ring, so the eigenvalues give the local Smith valuations there. At p, the distinguished p×p block P reduces to J_p−I_p. Its square modulo p is I_p−2J_p but more directly (J_p−I_p)(−I_p−J_p)=I_p since J_p²=0 modulo p; the stated invertibility is valid even though constants and the sum-zero subspace do not give a direct sum in this field. With R the remaining incidence matrix and W=vI+J, block elimination gives the Schur complement u(I+RWP⁻¹Rᵗ). The bracket reduces to p copies of I_{p−1}+J_{p−1}, each of rank p−2 over the residue field. There are therefore p unit factors, p(p−2) factors of valuation a and p factors of valuation at least a+1. For all odd p, including a=1, both α and β have valuation one; the determinant forces the last p valuations to be exactly a+1. This proves the rank and p-primary assertions. At every other prime dividing β, v and c are units since β−vc=p²; at primes not dividing β the displayed factors have one zero valuation, p(p−1) valuations of v and p−1 of vc. These multisets match the local splittings. The positive factors form a divisibility chain (in particular p divides c and the last ratio is β/p), so the local comparisons identify the full integral form. Independently computed integer Smith diagonals for (3,1), (3,6), (5,1), (5,3) agree.
residual_risks: The examples do not prove the all-parameter theorem; the prime-local argument does. Neither even p nor deeper prime powers are covered.

value.rationale: The prime square is the first cyclic order with an intermediate residue layer and no squarefree product reduction. For this natural integer kernel the entire finite cokernel gives torsion multiplicities at the defining prime and elsewhere, information not captured by rational eigenvalues or the largest factor. The powered family is uniform rather than a handpicked example, and the integral Schur calculation supplies exactly the local information unavailable by averaging at p.
residual_risks: Value is the exact full cokernel for the stated family, not a general classification at higher prime powers.
